item.title: Things to do in San Diego this weekend
item.description: San Diego County is hosting a variety of events this weekend, including the "The Art of Banksy Without Limits" exhibit, San Diego Museum Month, Gulls vs. Reign on Star Wars Night, Padres FanFest, Tu B'Shvat Food Forest Festival, San Diego Restaurant Week, and the Farmers Insurance Open.

item.title: VIDEO: Friendly sea lion hangs out on kayak in La Jolla
item.description: A sea lion hopped onto a woman's kayak in La Jolla Cove and made himself comfortable next to her, but she resisted his advances and followed the recommended guidelines of staying at least 50 feet away from wild sea lions.

item.title: Brief cooldown following record-breaking heat
item.description: San Diego County inland valleys experienced record-breaking heat on Friday, with highs reaching the 80s, but a cooldown is expected to begin on Monday and last until Wednesday.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of assault after targeting women hikers in Carlsbad
item.description: A 22-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of assaulting several women hikers at the Calavera Nature Preserve in Carlsbad, after being identified by a victim and taken into custody by police.

item.title: 13-year-old girl critically injured in Oceanside hit-and-run
item.description: Oceanside Police are searching for a driver who fled the scene after a hit-and-run collision that seriously injured a 13-year-old girl on Friday evening.

item.title: Man arrested in Arizona on suspicion of carjacking Lexus in San Diego
item.description: A man was carjacked at a North City gas station early Saturday morning, and the suspect was later taken into custody by Arizona law enforcement after the vehicle was located via its tracking system.

item.title: State of local emergency declared in Carlsbad due to water main break
item.description: The City of Carlsbad has declared a local state of emergency due to a water main break at a busy intersection, prompting emergency road repairs and a 36-hour timeline for completion.

item.title: Select San Diego streets to get metered parking in February
item.description: San Diego will be installing metered parking on select streets in February in several communities, including Normal Heights, Kensington, Talmadge, and City Heights, to promote turnover and improve the chances of people finding a parking spot.

item.title: San Diego’s Iranian community rallies for a fourth week, calls for regime change in Iran
item.description: Hundreds of local Iranians and supporters gathered in San Diego to call for regime change in Iran, citing the ongoing internet blackout and brutality of the current regime.

item.title: Mira Mesa community rally for "ICE Out Everywhere" movement
item.description: Demonstrators gathered at a Mira Mesa intersection to protest Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations and show solidarity with affected communities.
